item.body: The first taught slot2 trial stopped during horizontal entry at X224.65/Y-135.35/Z296 when grip feedback reached4.117mm (target3.9, accepted upper4.1). Operator confirmed contact, then reported a corrected setup. Preserve the failed trial; settled feedback does not prove a false alarm. New launcher operator_ui/run_hotel_slot_trial.py --slot 2 or --slot 3 previews offline; --execute explicitly confirms empty/free jaws, plate flat in HOME, selected slot empty, removed obstruction, clear empty connector and loaded approach, hands clear and E-stop supervised. It uses accepted pickup then stops held before release; no automatic retry or fault reset. Slot3 remains a first live trial, slot4 blocked. Starts only from bounded near-HOME area, never recovers from inside rack.
item.title: Slot2 first trial caught; operator corrected setup; supervised CLI available
